QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Flying Pill
QuestInfo.0: Icarus in Kerning City longs to fly through the sky. Is it really possible? Go see if you can help.
QuestInfo.1:
Icarus found a recipe for Flying Medicine to take him into the skies. To make #b#t4031163##k, he needs #b50 #t4000207##k items and #b20 #t4031165##k items. 

#i4000207##t4000207# #b#c4000207##k / 50
#i4031165##t4031165# #b#c4031165##k / 20
QuestInfo.2: Icarus has his Flying Medicine, thanks to your help. Only one way to find out if that stuff works...

0.0: I was trying to make a hot-air balloon so I could soar through the sky, but I ran into some... boo-boos. The sort of boo-boos that a helpful adventurer like yourself could fix! You HAVE to help me, okay?!

yes.0: I can't believe I'd never thought of Flying Medicine! All I need is the materials and I can zoom through the clouds!
yes.1: I can make the #b#t4031163##k with #b50 #t4000207##k items and #b20 #t4031165##k items. Witchgrass Leaves can be plucked from purple flowers in the Swamp Region. As for #b#t4000207#s, eliminate the monsters in the #rExcavation Site: Closed Area#k.

no.0: You really don't trust me? This is gonna work, I'm telling you!

1.0: Did you bring the materials for the potion?

yes.0: My dreams... they're finally going to come true! Thanks to you, I'm going to spit on SO MANY PEOPLE!!

item.0: You still haven't gathered all the materials for the medicine? I need #b50 #t4000207##k items and #b20 #t4031165##k items.
